plainText:
Toru Nara (Japanese: 奈良徹 Nara Tōru) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Nara was born on May 7, 1980, in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He began his work on the during , voicing Sinnoh Elite Four member Flint, his best-known role in that work. Then, he voiced characters of the day Glenn and Nico in and , respectively. Nara is currently affiliated with Kenyu Office.
